subject.title: fix(agents): tighten grepSchema context/limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the built-in grep tool intentionally reject fractional `context` and `limit` values at schema validation rather than continuing to accept and normalize or mis-handle them at runtime?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but this is an externally observable tightening of an existing model-facing tool schema and repository policy treats that compatibility choice as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Adopt integer-only counts
options.body: Confirm that these fields are counts, retain `Type.Integer`, and merge once the refreshed head passes required checks.

options.title: Preserve permissive input
options.body: Keep `Type.Number` and explicitly normalize fractional values in runtime code if backward acceptance is considered part of the contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt integer-only counts
recommendation.body: Confirm that these fields are counts, retain `Type.Integer`, and merge once the refreshed head passes required checks.
